title: Assessing gender bias in medical and scientific masked language models with StereoSet

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating masked language models using StereoSet's Context Association Tests (CATs), which measure the probability of the model filling in blanks with stereotypical, anti-stereotypical, or unrelated words.
